build_ObbMetrics_for_2d_eval: build an ObbMetrics instance with eval_2d=True to evaluate 2D bounding box detections across ARIA cameras
build_ObbMetrics_for_3d_eval: build an ObbMetrics instance with eval_3d=True to evaluate 3D oriented bounding box detections across cameras
update_ObbMetrics_with_predictions: update the ObbMetrics object with prediction and target ObbTW objects for a given camera
compute_ObbMetrics_results: compute and return a dictionary of 2D and 3D mean average precision metrics per camera
reset_ObbMetrics_state: reset all 2D and 3D metric accumulators in ObbMetrics to clear previous evaluation state
